purpose: Reviewable visual concepts for the five currently published Kairos League players.
policy: These are AI-generated fictional portraits, not photographs of actual people.
Ages and hometown cues were taken from current structured canon. All five nationalities remain TBD.
Appearance, skin tone, facial features, hair, glasses and body type are visual proposals, not newly confirmed biographical canon.
Do not infer nationality, ethnicity, ancestry, citizenship or residence from a portrait.
The backdrop is a hometown-inspired visual treatment, not an archived narrative event or actual photo location.
Black and gold reference a documented Kairos Counter-Strike uniform color scheme; the League shirt design here is a draft interpretation.
The plain KAIROS chest text is a placeholder, not approved logo artwork.
No accepted sponsors are listed in the organization record, so no sponsor marks are shown.
Do not auto-publish these drafts or modify canonical player records to match their appearance.

portraits.altText: AI-generated draft portrait of Noah Bennett, known as rkN, in a black and gold Kairos jersey with a blurred Seattle-inspired backdrop.
portraits.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a single fictional esports player's photographic portrait for Kairospedia. Create ONE person, a vertical 2:3 portrait, framed from mid torso to comfortably above the entire head, centered with adequate crop margin for a narrow wiki infobox. Believable documentary sports media-day photography, natural human anatomy and asymmetry, actual visible pores and tiny skin blemishes, fine stray hairs, ordinary teenage build and proportions. Eye-level 85mm lens look, f/5.6, broad softbox/window light, gentle natural shadows, realistic neutral color, modest dynamic range, unretouched editorial photograph, focused face and slightly blurred background. No beauty retouching, waxy skin, generic handsome model face, older-looking jawline, bodybuilder build, beard, neon gaming lights, cinematic smoke, lens flare, halo, HDR, illustration, CGI, 3D render, plastic skin, national flags or costume stereotypes. Wardrobe: consistent modest matte black short-sleeved esports crew-neck jersey, narrow muted-gold collar piping, one thin muted-gold line along each shoulder seam, natural polyester weave and ordinary clothing folds, no sponsors, no badges, no emblem, no invented logo. Only small plain muted-gold text 'KAIROS' on wearer's left chest; no other shirt text. Arms relaxed below frame; do not cross arms. No caption or graphic text outside jersey. This is fictional visual development, not an existing person's likeness or a claim about ethnicity or citizenship. Preserve stated narrative age. Background is a soft-focus printed hometown-themed studio backdrop, not a claim that a canonical event occurred there. Same restrained photography treatment across the roster, but never reuse faces.
Subject: Noah Bennett, nickname rkN, fictional Kairos League of Legends player. Age 17 at narrative date 2026-11-24. Canonical city: Seattle. Nationality and ethnicity are unconfirmed; appearance choices are non-canonical art proposals.
Individual visual direction: A visibly seventeen-year-old boy with light-medium skin, a compact softly rounded face, gentle small rounded chin, slightly prominent ears, dark-brown eyes, medium straight dark-brown hair in a genuinely untidy side-swept fringe with uneven strands. Small sparse blemishes on forehead, youthful cheeks; clean shaven. Slender shoulders, slightly self-conscious but relaxed posture, lips closed with a small asymmetrical smile. No glasses. Backdrop: very muted cool slate and evergreen tones with a barely visible out-of-focus Seattle waterfront/urban silhouette on a studio background. Keep the backdrop subdued and non-touristic. This is the first portrait in a set; make him an ordinary individual rather than a celebrity or fashion model.
